AUDIT_STATUS: CORRECTED - per-tensor error data and savings stand
AUDIT_NOTE: Per-tensor proxy_error/mse/max_err and the savings figures are sound, as is the statement that a text-only suite cannot show vision KLD impact. Corrections: round_trip_cosine and overall_cosine are invalid (fp32 norm under-accumulation); overall_mse and overall_proxy_error are UNWEIGHTED per-tensor means, so pos_embed supplies 33.3% of the reported overall MSE while being 0.579% of parameters (parameter-weighted K8 MSE is 9.38e-09); the combined embed+vision K6 saving is 2.162 GB, not 2.48 GB. 'Near-lossless' was a weight-space claim only - output fidelity is now backed by a functional red/blue vision test (see audit control C2).
title: Trellis K6/K8 Vision Tower Round-Trip Error
method: EXL3 trellis K6 and K8 round-trip on all 111 2D vision weight tensors (27 ViT blocks × 4 weights + merger × 2 + pos_embed). quantize_exl3 (uncalibrated, meta Hessian) + ext.reconstruct + hadamard_fold_weight. MLP weights with dim 4304 (not 128-aligned) padded to 4352 before encoding, cropped back after. KLD suite is text-only (no images), so vision weights don't affect KLD — this measures round-trip error on the weights themselves.

key_findings: Trellis K8: proxy error 0.000020, MSE 1.06e-08, cosine 0.99998 — near-lossless.
Trellis K6: proxy error 0.000322, MSE 1.20e-07, cosine 0.99983 — still excellent, 16x higher proxy error than K8 but cosine within 0.015%.
Proxy error scaling K6→K8 is ~16x, consistent with the embedding scaling (K4→K6 was ~18x, K6→K8 was ~17x).
Vision K6 proxy error (0.000322) matches embedding K6 proxy error (0.000324) — trellis coding is consistent across tensor types and sizes.
Padding for 4304-dim MLP weights works equally well at both K6 and K8 — proxy errors indistinguishable from non-padded weights.
K6 saves 0.573 GB (62%), K8 saves 0.459 GB (50%) vs BF16. K6 saves 0.114 GB more than K8.
pos_embed is the outlier at both bit widths: K6 MSE=4.12e-06 (34x higher than other K6 tensors), K8 MSE=3.93e-07 (37x higher). Small tensor, large dynamic range.
Vision tower does NOT affect the text-only KLD suite, so KLD is unchanged regardless of vision quantization.
Combined savings with embeddings: K6 embed (1.91 GB) + K6 vision (0.573 GB) = 2.48 GB; K8 embed (1.27 GB) + K8 vision (0.459 GB) = 1.73 GB from BF16.
